examples.title: 1 · Hello World
examples.description: The smallest flow: Inject to Debug. Press the inject button and watch the Debug panel.

examples.title: 2 · Function Transform
examples.description: Write Python in a FunctionNode to reshape the message payload. Fires every 2s.

examples.title: 3 · Switch Routing
examples.description: Route a random number to different outputs with SwitchNode; tag one branch with ChangeNode.

examples.title: 4 · Flow Control
examples.description: Gate (toggle live), Delay rate-limiting, RateProbe and Counter for back-pressure.

examples.title: 5 · Webcam Viewer
examples.description: First vision flow: Camera to ImageViewer. Needs a webcam and the vision extra.

examples.title: 6 · Webcam + YOLO
examples.description: YOLO object detection with an annotated view plus a detection-summary debug branch.

examples.title: 7 · Blur People (privacy)
examples.description: Detect, filter to the 'person' class, then Gaussian-blur each detection box.

examples.title: 8 · Video + YOLO Recorder
examples.description: VideoReader to YOLO to preview and VideoWriter. Pick a video file in the reader's properties first.

examples.title: 9 · MQTT Pub/Sub
examples.description: Publish every 5s and receive it back on a wildcard subscription. Pick a broker in the MQTT nodes.

examples.title: 10 · Person Alert to MQTT
examples.description: Capstone: camera to YOLO to confidence/label filters to a rate-limited MQTT alert.

examples.title: 11 · UDP Socket Bridge
examples.description: Two halves of a bridge to another system: Inject to UDP Out (7401), and UDP In (7402) to Debug. Copy the matching Node-RED flow from either node's Info panel.
examples.requires: core + a peer on the other end

examples.title: 12 · Slider-Driven Crop
examples.description: Four live sliders drive a crop region on an uploaded image, previewed in an Image Viewer as you drag.

examples.title: 13 · Track & Trace
examples.description: Video to YOLO to SV Tracker to SV Annotate: persistent track IDs with colored trace ribbons following each object.

examples.title: 14 · Line Counter
examples.description: Tracked objects crossing a virtual line are counted in/out, with one event message per crossing. Draw the line on a live frame from the node's properties.

examples.title: 15 · Zone Occupancy
examples.description: A polygon zone counts who is inside and emits enter/exit events. Draw the zone on a live webcam frame from the node's properties.

examples.title: 16 · Annotator Gallery
examples.description: One image, one YOLO, six SV Annotate styles side by side: classic, rounded, corners, broadcast, blur, pixelate.

examples.title: 17 · Heat Map
examples.description: Movement accumulates into a heat map over time; a rate-limited branch saves a snapshot every 10 seconds.

examples.title: 18 · Privacy Blur
examples.description: Example 7 without the code: LabelFilter keeps people, SV Annotate's Blur checkbox replaces the 20-line blur function.

examples.title: 19 · Detection Log
examples.description: SV Detection Filter keeps confident big boxes, SV Sink logs one CSV row per detection; rejected detections go to a second Debug.
